next.reason: The 1985 rule only makes the relative RECORD clause the sequential one. 2023 writes one RECORD clause (13.18.43) into FD Format 1 (sequential, §2023:13.4.5.3 SR5) and Format 2 (relative or indexed, §2023:13.4.5.3 SR7), so the sameness holds; the clause's content is carried by the sequential rule's record.
